The approved 23:55-00:05 GMT rollover blackout is evaluated from raw TimeCurrent broker time. It is shifted by the broker offset and changes with DST instead of following the card's UTC clock.

The card requires the initial stop at the M5 SMA60 baseline plus or minus exactly three pips. The EA silently clamps that distance into an invented 0.5-to-3.5 ATR corridor, changing the stop, position size, 2.5R target, and 1R trailing trigger.

The approved 2.0% daily realized-loss entry halt, 2.5% daily equity hard stop, and 5.0% total drawdown stop are not configured. OnInit calls no QM_KillSwitchInit with the card thresholds, so generic framework defaults cannot prove the approved risk contract.
OnTick applies spread and rollover entry filters before Strategy_ManageOpenPosition. Existing exposure can therefore lose its approved SMA trailing updates during those entry-only blocks.

OnInit declares no QM_FrameworkDeclareExecutionContract for the M5 host cadence, parameterless QM_IsNewBar does not make that contract fail-closed, and the EA adds the unused Trade/Trade.mqh include outside the QM_Common include chain.

The four set headers remain incomplete and lack build_hash, and no current strict PASS or smoke report exists, so build_result fails and smoke_sanity remains UNKNOWN.
